learning_outcomes.text: Has knowledge about nuclear power systems.
Has a basic knowledge about heat generation in reactors, working principles and types of nuclear power plants.
Understands the design differences between power plants with different operating principles.

syllabus_topics: ATOMIC AND NUCLEAR STRUCTURE AND REACTIONS: Atomic structure, the structure of heavy atoms, the chemical reaction, energy from nuclear fission&fussion
ATOMIC AND NUCLEAR STRUCTURE AND REACTIONS: Conversion and breeding, energy from fission and fuel burnup, radioactivity, decay rates.
NEUTRONS AND THEIR INTERACTIONS: Neutron energies, fission and thermal neutrons, neutron flux and reaction rates. The 1/V region, the resonance region.
REACTOR HEAT GENERATION: Neutron conservation, heat generation rate in fuel, the fission energy in reactors, heat generated by a single fuel element.
HEAT CONDUCTION IN REACTOR ELEMENTS: Heat flow out of solid-plate-type fuel elements, cylindrical fuel elements and spherically shaped fuel.
NUCLEAR POWER SYSTEMS: The fusion reactor, neutron energy and moderation, fission power plants, gascooled- reactor power plants, fluid-fueled reactor.
BOILING REACTORS: Boiling reactor mass and heat balance, driving pressure in a boiling channel, average density in a boiling channel.
PRESSURIZED-WATER REACTORS: Materials for water reactors, steam generators, reactor-system pressurizers, chemical-shim control.
PRESSURIZED-WATER REACTOR POWER PLANTS: The shipping port atomic power station, the point beach reactor power plant, Pickering heavy-water power plant
GAS-COOLED REACTORS: Thermodynamic cycles; the direct open cycle, indirect open cycle and the direct closed cycle, gas-coolant radioactivity.
GAS-COOLED REACTOR POWER PLANTS: Analysis of the gas-steam system; the simple cycle, analysis of the gas steam system. The dual-pressure cycle.
FAST-BREEDER REACTORS: Nuclear reactions in fast-breeder reactors, conversion and breeding, the conversion (breeding) ratio.
FAST-BREEDER REACTORS: Nuclear reactions in fast-breeder reactors, conversion and breeding, the conversion (breeding) ratio.
FAST BREEDER REACTORS AND POWER PLANTS: Reactor plant arrangements, the Enrico Fermi nuclear power plant, the Sefor plant.
bibliography: Awwad N., Nuclear Power Plants, IntechOpen, 2021.
Lamarsh J. R., Barata A.J., Introduction to Nuclear Engineering, Third Edition, Prentice Hall, New Jersey, 2001.
